notes: New: a Stats page (today, overall, a chart over time, pace and finish date); Progress shows today's three to-dos as check boxes.
New: double tap a word to mark it as a mistake, or to remove its mistake; double tap again to undo.
New: shake the phone to report a problem (Settings, off by default); the report button moved into the menu.
New: Android Auto: a Pages tab (first page, last page, repeats), Recite buttons, Find where I am, and the ayah's text on screen.
Change: in the car, Listen and Recite take over a recitation running on the phone; it is saved first.
Fix: no more empty hidden word where one written word is said as two (for example ya bunayya, ya ayyuha).
Fix: + Mistake, + Correct and Remove mistake now colour the word at once.
Fix: Hidden and Blind always show the Recite buttons, and a Listen button with a cross leaves Listen.
